The data folder's `config.yml`. A missing key takes its default; unknown top-level keys are kept as they are.

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `port` | 7477 | The engine's HTTP port on 127.0.0.1 (the UI, the app and the MCP proxy use it). `AITT_PORT` overrides it. |
| `statuses` | 7 items (below) | The workflow statuses, in order, each with a `name`, a `type` and a `color` (the defaults are below). |
| `workspaces` | {} | Repo (workspace) name → project slug: the project an agent's new issue goes to when it names none. |
| `needsYou` | {"statuses":["Waiting","In Review"],"labels":["Needs decision","Needs review"]} | Which `statuses` and `labels` put an issue in Home ▸ Needs you (and the menu). |
| `stalled` | {"idleHours":24,"windowDays":7,"reopens":2,"sessions":3} | When open work counts as stalled and joins Needs you. `idleHours`: In Progress with no edit or comment for this long. `windowDays`, `reopens`, `sessions`: in that many days, reopened (back to In Progress from Done, Canceled, Duplicate, Todo or Backlog; never from Waiting) at least `reopens` times, or more than `sessions` agent sessions since it was last Done. 0 turns a rule off. |
| `ci` | {"enabled":true,"refreshMinutes":2} | CI status on linked GitHub PRs, fetched in the background with your `gh`. `enabled`: false turns it off (no `gh` calls, no badges, nothing in Needs you). `refreshMinutes`: how often an open PR is re-checked; merged and closed PRs are checked until their checks settle, then never again. |
| `nextNumber` | {} | Project key → the next issue number. Maintained by the engine. |
| `theme` | "graphite" | The UI theme, the same in the browser and the app window: `graphite`, `dark`, `light`, `system` (Match macOS), `midnight`, `plum`, `paper`, `high-contrast`, or the id of a theme file in `themes/` (`themes/ocean.yml` is `ocean`). Without a `theme`, and for an unknown id, the UI shows Graphite. Set it from the app's Settings or ⌘K ▸ Theme; see the Themes guide. |
| `hiddenProjects` | [] | Project slugs hidden from the app window, the browser UI and the menu bar (`_none` is the issues without a project). They appear nowhere except by direct link: not in the sidebar, lists, Home, saved views, the board, the activity feed, counts (a visible epic's sub-issue count and progress leave them out), filter and group options, search, Needs you or quick capture, and no notifications; a visible issue names a hidden child, parent, blocker or related issue by id only. A direct link (`#/issue/ID`, `aitt://issue/ID`, the project page) or an exact id in ⌘K still opens them, and agents see no change. Set it from the app's Settings ▸ Hidden projects (the only place for `_none`) or a project page's Hide project / Unhide. A view setting, not access control: the endpoint turns away requests marked as an agent's, a header check rather than enforcement. A slug that names no project is ignored. |

## Default statuses

| Name | Type | Color |
|---|---|---|
| Backlog | `backlog` | `#bec2c8` |
| Todo | `unstarted` | `#e2e2e2` |
| In Progress | `started` | `#f2c94c` |
| Waiting | `started` | `#f2994a` |
| Done | `completed` | `#5e6ad2` |
| Canceled | `canceled` | `#95a2b3` |
| Duplicate | `duplicate` | `#95a2b3` |

## Defaults as YAML

```yaml
port: 7477
statuses: [{"name":"Backlog","type":"backlog","color":"#bec2c8"},{"name":"Todo","type":"unstarted","color":"#e2e2e2"},{"name":"In Progress","type":"started","color":"#f2c94c"},{"name":"Waiting","type":"started","color":"#f2994a"},{"name":"Done","type":"completed","color":"#5e6ad2"},{"name":"Canceled","type":"canceled","color":"#95a2b3"},{"name":"Duplicate","type":"duplicate","color":"#95a2b3"}]
workspaces: {}
needsYou: {"statuses":["Waiting","In Review"],"labels":["Needs decision","Needs review"]}
stalled: {"idleHours":24,"windowDays":7,"reopens":2,"sessions":3}
ci: {"enabled":true,"refreshMinutes":2}
nextNumber: {}
theme: "graphite"
hiddenProjects: []
```
